solves.reasoning: (A) don't ___ obvious signs → exhibit. (B) likelihood of dying does not ___ with age(노화 안함) → increase. (C) more ___ to trees → similar.
(A) ___ signs of aging → obvious. (B) may ___ clues → provide. (C) learn ___ things → fascinating.
(A) able to ___ entire body parts → regenerate. (B) how ___ findings to human aging → relevant. (C) biology is ___ → universal.
②decrease: likelihood of dying does not ___ with age — 문맥상 increase가 맞으므로 decrease 부적절.
④easy: 쥐 발견조차 인간에 적용하기 어렵다 → difficult가 맞으므로 easy 부적절.
③farther: 쥐는 생물학적으로 우리와 더 가깝다 → closer가 맞으므로 farther 부적절.
unlike most every ___ → animal(동물). plant/object/season은 문맥 부적절.
rats or mice, which are ___ → mammals(포유류).
regenerate body parts, or even a whole ___ → organism(유기체).
obvious(분명한) ≈ evident(명백한). hidden은 반의어.
fascinating(흥미로운) ≈ interesting. dull은 반의어.
entire(전체의) ≈ complete. partial은 반의어.
increase(증가) ↔ decrease(감소). grow/rise는 유사어, remain은 무관축.
fundamental(근본적인) ↔ minor(사소한). essential/basic은 유사어, sudden은 무관축.
(A) biologically close to us = 가까운, (B) close the window = 닫다.
living or existing forever; never dying = immortal(불멸의). mortal은 반대.
형용사 immortal을 수식 → 부사 자리. biology(명사) → biologically(부사).
명사 aging을 수식 → 형용사 자리. appear(동사) → apparent(형용사).
even discoveries in rats or mice ... are ___ into humans → difficult to translate.
clues about how to ___ → defeat the aging process (노화 과정을 물리치다).
